AuthorityRoute.description:
One routing determination: this authority applies to this case, or it does not, and why.

ADR-003: routing is implemented, not stubbed, from day one. Building it after the fact is a
refactor of every analysis path.

A route with `applies=False` is retained rather than dropped. A reviewer needs to see that
national-security eligibility was considered and declined, and on what basis — an absent
route is indistinguishable from an oversight.

rationale.description: Deterministic explanation of the routing rule that fired. Not model prose.
rationale.title: Rationale

blocking_gap.description: Set when routing could not be determined from explicit metadata. Blueprint §10.2: missing or inconsistent routing fields produce a blocking information gap.
blocking_gap.title: Blocking Gap

AuthorityRoute.title: AuthorityRoute

DecisionDomain.description:
The distinct legal authorities this system analyses against.

ADR-003 and blueprint §2.1: suitability, fitness, PIV credentialing, and national-security
eligibility are distinct authorities with distinct criteria. Collapsing them produces
analysis that is wrong in a way that is hard to detect, so every finding names exactly one.
DecisionDomain.title: DecisionDomain

RoutingBasis.description:
Why an authority was or was not routed.

Blueprint §10.2: the system may not infer routing from document content. `INFERRED` is
absent from this enum on purpose — there is no legitimate value for it.
RoutingBasis.title: RoutingBasis

description: The complete routing decision for a run — every domain considered, none omitted.
